summary: 36-year-old man injured his ankle hiking out from St Louis Lake; 20 GCSAR members responded with ATVs, splinted the ankle, and assisted him to the road washout where he was handed to his wife.
location: St Louis Lake trail, ~1 mi above the road washout, St Louis Creek
notes: Victim contacted wife via satellite messenger (no cell service up St Louis Creek). All out of the field by 3:30 pm. Litter ride + ATV transport across creek.
